chapter: Excelsior Brass Band and Red Allen's band
title: Red Allen goes north; Bocage joins Kid Thomas and later stops playing
summary: Allen met King Oliver and asked Bocage whether to go; Bocage declined to follow, played with Kid Thomas a couple of years, then quit about twenty years ago.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, John stayed with the band until Allen went off. Like I said, you see, when Allen first left, yeah, Allen met with King Oliver, you see,
Oliver's sentence for him. He was on the boat at the time.

Yeah. And, uh, so he asked me, uh, what did you say? He was a bass player? Yeah. He was a bass player. He was a bass player. Yeah. He was a bass player. Yeah. He was a bass player. Yeah. He was a bass player. Yeah. He was a bass player. Yeah.

And, uh, so he asked me, what must he do? I told him, I said, well, you young. That time Allen was young, I told him, I said, you can go on up, cause you can make it. Cause he was a bass player, a bass player. He was a bass player. And he didn't know nothing else but jazz.

Yeah. So, well, finally, he went up and he wrote me, asked me if I wanted to come up. But I told him, no, at that time I was playing by head and that fella's up there, it would make me shame about him when I tell him. So I told him, no, I didn't want to come up there. So, that's where I started playing with Thomas. Well, I played with Thomas about, oh, a couple of years I fooled around with Thomas. And I just got tired and give it up altogether. Just stop, stop playing. When did you stop? What year would that be? Oh, that'd been over around about 20 years back, I guess, when I stopped playing.
Well, you must have played with somebody after you played with Thomas, huh? Who, with Thomas?
No, after Thomas I didn't play with anyone anymore.
You didn't even play with Pete?
No, I just, I played with Pete in the brass band, but I never played in the orchestra with Pete.
